g.text: TP1..TP4 are davedarko's four 4 x 4 mm solder pads, drawn on the board only (bare copper, nothing to buy).

g.desc: TP1..TP4 are davedarko's four 4 x 4 mm solder pads, drawn on the board only (bare copper, nothing to buy).

g.text: R1 feeds the left arm pad TP4 (ARM_A), R2 the left foot pad TP3 (LEG_A): these are the + pads. The right arm TP2 and right foot TP1 are GND.

g.desc: R1 feeds the left arm pad TP4 (ARM_A), R2 the left foot pad TP3 (LEG_A): these are the + pads. The right arm TP2 and right foot TP1 are GND.

g.text: A hand-soldered 5 mm LED goes across one + pad and one - pad, long leg on +; the maker's 3D-printed konpeito candy

g.desc: A hand-soldered 5 mm LED goes across one + pad and one - pad, long leg on +; the maker's 3D-printed konpeito candy

g.text: (original/Soot Sprites/Kompeito.scad) slips over it. 1.3 k gives about 1 mA for a red LED, about 0.4 mA for white or blue on badge power.

g.desc: (original/Soot Sprites/Kompeito.scad) slips over it. 1.3 k gives about 1 mA for a red LED, about 0.4 mA for white or blue on badge power.

g.text: Front copper: left half = VLOAD, right half = GND (the maker's two halves, used as power planes as he did).

g.desc: Front copper: left half = VLOAD, right half = GND (the maker's two halves, used as power planes as he did).

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED pads. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED pads. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
